exceptions.reason: Build-time only: expo 58 -> @expo/metro -> metro-file-map -> micromatch 4 -> braces 3. Metro uses it to match the project's own watch and ignore globs while bundling the mobile app; it is not shipped in the app and never sees untrusted patterns. braces 3.0.3 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.

Build-time only: expo 58 -> @expo/cli (and @expo/code-signing-certificates). The CLI uses it for iOS signing identities and to sign update manifests, neither of which this repository configures; it is not shipped in the app, and the advisory concerns verifying RSA signatures from others. node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest release, so no patched version exists.
